content: 9legacy is a curated patch set on the frozen 2015-01-10 Plan 9 4e release and is the effective maintenance channel (its maintainers also run Go's plan9 builders). 9front is the active evolutionary fork. plan9port's issue tracker shows ongoing host-tool portability fixes. Lesson for Harvey: the dormant-upstream risk concentrates in host-environment assumptions (distro EOL, qemu/expect drift, archived release artifacts), not in the Plan 9 C codebase itself, which is stable.
